title: A retrieval postmortem template, and a public incident log
body:
### The problem

[`docs/40-operations/`](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/tree/main/docs/40-operations) has a runbook for a live incident and
nothing for afterwards. The
[incident runbook](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/60-cheatsheets/playbooks/retrieval-incident-runbook.md) ends
with *"write the detection gap down"* and there is nowhere to write it.

### The proposal

An issue template and `docs/40-operations/incident-log.md`:

```text
symptom            what a user saw, in their words
first hypothesis   including the wrong one, named
root cause         the mechanism
detection gap      why a user found it before a test did   <- the valuable line
regression test    the test that now fails against the broken state
what we did NOT fix and why
```

### Why the detection gap is the point

Every postmortem template has "root cause". Almost none have **"what measurement would have caught
this before a user did"**, which is the only line that changes what you build next.

This repository has three ready-made entries: [#1](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/issues/1), [#2](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/issues/2) and
[#7](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/issues/7). Backfilling them is a good first contribution.
